title: Free Property Valuation in Pondicherry & Kottakuppam
description: Know what your Puducherry property is worth. Free on-site valuation based on recent registrations and local deals, with a written range. Book it today.
h1: Property Valuation in Pondicherry, Free and On-Site
lead: A valuation is not a guess from a phone call. We visit the property, look at the documents, and compare it against what has actually been registered nearby.
wa: Hi, I want a free valuation for my property in ___

bullets: A price range your property can realistically fetch today, with the reasoning written out
Recent comparable transactions in your area
Guideline value versus market value, and what the gap means for you
What is pulling your price down and what is worth fixing before you list
An honest view of how long a sale is likely to take at each price point
Owners deciding whether to sell this year or wait
Families dividing property between siblings who need a fair number
Owners abroad who have not seen their property in years
Buyers who want to know if the asking price is reasonable before negotiating
paras: Thinking of selling afterwards? See [how selling works](/sell-property-pondicherry) and our [Kottakuppam area guide](/real-estate-kottakuppam).

items.a: Yes. We do not charge for the valuation and you are under no obligation to sell through us.

items.q: Will you just quote a low price to get a quick sale?
items.a: A valuation that gets your property sold cheap earns us less, not more — our fee is a percentage. We give you the range and the evidence behind it; the asking price is your decision.

items.q: Can you value a property I inherited and have not seen?
items.a: Yes. We visit, photograph and video the property, check the current document position and send everything to you wherever you are.
